provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the Gaia licence page and the ESDC terms: data of the ESA space science archives under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO; prior to any commercial use a licence request goes to data.licences@esa.int (the contact above is for that); storage and redistribution are allowed non-commercially under the licence. Credit "ESA/Gaia/DPAC"; also cite the release papers (Gaia DR3...). No rate limit published: the archive FAQ says there are limits on data retrieved and query duration, quotas differing for anonymous and registered users (the "Gaia Archive user quotas" help section, not read); an older FAQ gives 90 min / 3,000,000 rows for anonymous async jobs. Temporary quota changes via the Gaia Helpdesk.
